note: Lean allows each anchor location to carry up to `μ` marks and states the bound with that factor, which for `μ = 1` is [M]'s `B_k|I| ≤ 64 cover`; the proof goes through a ring path of the cover, not a tree traversal.

snippet.text:
theorem mixed_pack (hB : 8≤B) (hh : Occupancy o μ) (s : Finset V)
    (hr : 2 ≤ (s.image o).card) (hs : (↑(s.image o) : Set (Site n)).Pairwise fun x y => B^2 ≤ separation x y)
    (X : Support n) (hp : s.image o ⊆ X) : B*s.card ≤ 64*coverNumber B X * μ := by
  have h := Work.I01.answer n (Site n) id B hB (s.image o) hs hr X (by simpa using hp)
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hh.card s)).trans (le_trans (by rw [Nat.mul_assoc] : B*((s.image o).card*μ) ≤ B*(s.image o).card*μ) (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h))

proof_context.conclusion: For a family with occupancy at most `μ`, at least two distinct anchors pairwise `B^2` apart and `B ≥ 8`, `B * s.card ≤ 64 * coverNumber B X * μ`.

let gap := B^2 - 2*B
  have hsq : 8*B ≤ B^2 := by
    rw [pow_two]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right B hB
  have hpos : 0 < gap := by dsimp [gap]; omega
  -- A gap in distance forces a gap in time, paying two radii.
  have apart (i : V) (hi : i ∈ F) (j : V) (hj : j ∈ F) (hne : i ≠ j)
      (hij : t i ≤ t j) : t i + gap ≤ t j := by
    have hspan := Corona.path_span hstep (t i) (t j) hij (ht j hj)
    have h1 := separation_triangle (f i) (R (t i)) (f j)
    have h2 := separation_triangle (R (t i)) (R (t j)) (f j)
    rw [separation_comm (f i) (R (t i))] at h1
    have := hnear i hi
    have := hnear j hj
    have := hsep i hi j hj hne

proof_context.conclusion: Anchors `B^2` apart are visited at times at least `B^2 - 2B` apart along a path through the cover, the gap argument behind the covering estimate.
